title: OpenBot
lede: OpenBot, from CopilotKit, is a self-hostable workspace for AI agents with identity, approvals, audit logs and spending limits built in, so a company decides what each agent may touch.

points: SSO and SCIM tie access to the company directory, and tool permissions can be set per bot, role or person.
Admins choose which actions run freely, which wait for a person's approval and which are blocked.
Agent activity is logged and exportable to an existing SIEM; usage and spend are tracked per bot and team.
Existing agents plug in over AG-UI and tools over MCP, with any model; the workspace can be white-labelled.
Skills an agent learns stay inside its permissions, so getting better at a task does not widen its access.

sections.text: IT and security teams that must sign off on agents touching company systems, and developers who want to bring their own agent and model and run it locally.
The launch comment says OpenBot is free for personal use on Mac and Windows. OpenBot for Business is in early access, with no price given.
